description: Multichain gas oracle: Next base fee and slow / standard / fast priority-fee tiers (10th, 50th, 90th percentile tips over the last 10 blocks) with suggested max fees, on base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, avalanche, bsc, base-sepolia. Source: publicnode JSON-RPC. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: base_fee_next_gwei, slow/standard/fast{priority_fee_gwei, max_fee_gwei}, legacy_gas_price_gwei.

network.description: one of base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, avalanche, bsc, base-sepolia (default base)

name: x420_chain_gas-oracle
